Visit note | 2025-02-24 11:30 AM | Dr. Rokeya Khatun, Obstetrics and Gynecology | Patient: Shampa Paul, 31, female. Ms. Paul consults today reporting discomfort, localized soreness, a thick white discharge, and persistent itching. She mentions these symptoms started after using a new scented soap bought in Keraniganj. She works as a garment factory worker and lives in Dhaka with her family. She reports no other systemic issues and has no known comorbidities. On examination, random blood glucose is 6.4 mmol/L, blood pressure is 128/79 mmHg, pulse is 70 bpm, and weight is 48 kg. Pelvic examination reveals erythema and cottage-cheese-like discharge. Assessment: Vulvovaginal candidiasis. Plan: a prescription was issued for targeted antifungal therapy. She was advised to wear cotton underwear, avoid scented soaps entirely, and keep the area dry. Follow-up in 2 weeks if symptoms do not clear.

Visit note | 2025-02-24 04:00 PM | Dr. Lubna Rahman, Endocrinology | Patient: Arifa Chowdhury, 45, female. Mrs. Chowdhury presents with persistent fatigue, working indoors all day, and painful muscle cramps in her limbs. She notes this discomfort was noticed after working in a windowless office in Bashundhara. She works as a CNG auto-rickshaw driver during her off-hours and has a known history of Essential hypertension. She denies recent falls, visual changes, or chest pain. Examination reveals a vitamin D level of 9 ng/mL, blood pressure of 146/93 mmHg, pulse of 92 bpm, and weight of 58 kg. Her heart and lung exams are unremarkable. Assessment: Vitamin D deficiency. Plan: a prescription was issued to replenish her vitamin stores. She was advised to get 20 minutes of morning sunlight daily and eat eggs and fish. Follow-up in 3 months with a repeat vitamin D level.

Visit note | 2025-02-24 04:00 PM | Dr. Habibur Rahman, Orthopedics | Patient: Kawsar Talukder, 57, male. Mr. Talukder describes being unable to reach behind the back, severe night pain in the shoulder, and being unable to raise the arm. He states the trouble began after a minor fall at home in Mohammadpur. He works as a hotel receptionist and has Type 2 diabetes mellitus. He denies numbness in the fingers or neck pain. Examination shows shoulder lifts only to 60 degrees with restriction in all directions. Other vitals: blood pressure 123/85 mmHg, pulse 82 bpm, weight 57 kg. Neurological exam of the upper limb is intact. Assessment: Adhesive capsulitis. Plan: a prescription was issued for pain management. He was advised to start physiotherapy, do pendulum exercises daily, and apply heat before exercise. Follow-up in 4 weeks with a physiotherapy review.

Visit note | 2025-02-24 04:30 PM | Dr. Zahid Hasan, Gastroenterology | Patient: Tahsin Uddin, 30, female. Ms. Uddin comes in complaining of cramping belly pain and symptoms worse with stress. She presents with urgent loose stools every morning with little pain. She mentions her discomfort began after a bout of food poisoning in Barishal. She works as an architect and has no chronic medical conditions. She denies weight loss, fever, or rectal bleeding. Examination shows a pain score 5/10 on abdominal palpation with mild lower quadrant tenderness. Other vitals: blood pressure 126/77 mmHg, pulse 82 bpm, weight 65 kg. Bowel sounds are normal. Assessment: Irritable bowel syndrome. Plan: a prescription was issued to regulate bowel function. She was advised to eat regular meals, keep a food diary, and reduce tea, fizzy drinks, and beans. Follow-up in 6 weeks with the food diary.

Visit note | 2025-02-25 10:30 AM | Dr. Zahid Hasan, Gastroenterology | Patient: Rashid Awal, 30, male. Mr. Awal reports severe belly cramps and vomiting. He presents with high fever and blood in the stool with little vomiting. He states the illness started after drinking tap water on a trip to Rampura. He works as a photographer and has no underlying comorbidities. He denies travel outside the country or chronic bowel complaints. Examination reveals a pulse 101 bpm, blood pressure 122/79 mmHg, and weight 83 kg. Abdomen is soft with diffuse tenderness and active bowel sounds. Assessment: Acute gastroenteritis. Plan: a prescription was issued for rehydration and symptom relief. He was advised to drink small sips of fluid often, eat rice, bananas, and toast, and wash hands before eating. Follow-up in 2 days if the stools do not settle.

Visit note | 2025-02-25 02:00 PM | Dr. Tanvir Ahmed, General Medicine | Patient: Hafsa Mondal, 48, female. Mrs. Mondal reports looking pale, getting breathless on the stairs, and constant tiredness. She explains this started after a stomach illness during a stay in Motijheel. She works as a lawyer and has Essential hypertension. She denies chest pain, dizziness, or black stools. Physical examination shows conjunctival pallor. Vitals: haemoglobin 9.6 g/dL, blood pressure 144/88 mmHg, pulse 69 bpm, weight 45 kg. Cardiovascular and respiratory exams are otherwise normal. Assessment: Iron deficiency anaemia. Plan: a prescription was issued for iron supplementation. She was advised to eat more lentils, spinach, liver, and eggs, and avoid tea within an hour of meals. Follow-up in 6 weeks with a repeat haemoglobin.

Visit note | 2025-02-25 02:00 PM | Dr. Jannatul Ferdous, Orthopedics | Patient: Puja Das, 76, female. Mrs. Das complains of knee pain on the stairs and a creaking knee. She notes the discomfort is worse since standing all day at a shop in Tongi. She works as a shopkeeper and has Type 2 diabetes mellitus. She denies locking, instability, or recent trauma. Examination reveals BMI 30.7, blood pressure 114/71 mmHg, pulse 86 bpm, and weight 79 kg. There is crepitus on knee flexion and mild tenderness around the patella without effusion. Assessment: Knee osteoarthritis. Plan: a prescription was issued for joint support and pain relief. She was advised to do thigh-strengthening exercises daily, lose weight, and avoid squatting and sitting cross-legged on the floor. Follow-up in 6 weeks with physiotherapy.

Visit note | 2025-02-25 02:30 PM | Dr. Sabrina Chowdhury, Cardiology | Patient: Hossain Siddique, 79, male. Mr. Siddique reports no other complaints and a high reading on a pharmacy machine. He explains this measurement was picked up at a pharmacy in Uttara while buying other medicines. He works as a shopkeeper and has no known medical comorbidities. He denies headaches, chest tightness, or visual disturbances. On examination, blood pressure is 158/93 mmHg, pulse is 89 bpm, and weight is 54 kg. Heart sounds are dual with no murmurs, and lungs are clear. Assessment: Essential hypertension. Plan: a prescription was issued to lower his blood pressure. He was advised to cut down on salt, pickles, and dried fish, walk 30 minutes daily, and check blood pressure at home twice a week. Follow-up in 1 month with home blood pressure readings.

Visit note | 2025-02-25 02:30 PM | Dr. Arif Hossain, Pulmonology | Patient: Mahfuz Gazi, 70, male. Mr. Gazi presents with more sputum than usual, breathlessness worse for several days, and a long history of smoking. He mentions his condition worsened after a cold caught at a crowded market in Noakhali. He works as a farmer and has no reported chronic illnesses. He denies chest pain or lower limb swelling. Examination shows SpO2 91% on room air, blood pressure 126/73 mmHg, pulse 84 bpm, and weight 64 kg. Chest auscultation reveals widespread wheezing and prolonged expiration. Assessment: COPD exacerbation. Plan: a prescription was issued for bronchodilators and supportive care. He was advised to stop smoking completely, avoid cooking smoke, and take the yearly flu vaccine. Follow-up in 1 week, sooner if breathing worsens.

Visit note | 2025-02-25 03:00 PM | Dr. Rafiqul Islam, Cardiology | Patient: Jahid Howlader, 53, male. Mr. Howlader visits the clinic today describing a heavy feeling in the chest that eases with rest within minutes and breathlessness on effort. He states that he first noticed this discomfort while climbing to a fourth-floor flat in Sirajganj. He works as a tailor, lives with his family in Dhaka, and has smoked cigarettes for over twenty years. He has no prior history of chronic systemic diseases. He denies palpitations, dizziness, or pain radiating to the jaw. Clinical examination reveals a blood pressure reading of 157/82 mmHg, a pulse rate of 81 bpm with a regular rhythm, and a weight of 85 kg. Heart sounds are normal with no added murmurs, and his chest is clear to auscultation. Assessment: Stable angina. Plan: a prescription was issued for cardiovascular protection and symptom management. He was advised to avoid heavy exertion until review, walk 20 minutes daily on flat ground, and stop smoking. Follow-up in 2 weeks with an ECG and fasting lipid profile.

Visit note | 2025-02-25 03:30 PM | Dr. Anisur Rahman, Ophthalmology | Patient: Morium Hossain, 45, female. Mrs. Hossain returns for review, reporting a red eye and eyelids stuck together in the morning. She states this started after a family member in Jatrabari had red eyes. She works as a restaurant cook and has a history of Essential hypertension. She denies pain deep in the eye or changes in vision. Examination shows visual acuity 6/9 in the right eye, blood pressure 152/94 mmHg, pulse 71 bpm, and weight 91 kg. Conjunctival injection and mucopurulent discharge are visible. Assessment: Bacterial conjunctivitis. Plan: a prescription was issued for antibiotic eye drops. She was advised to wash hands often, do not share towels, and stay away from work for two days. Follow-up in 1 week if not better.

He explains his first attack happened in a crowded lift in Badda. He works as an accountant and has no chronic medical history. He denies suicidal ideation or chronic low mood. Examination reveals about 5 panic attacks in the last month, blood pressure 113/78 mmHg, pulse 90 bpm, and weight 60 kg. Mental state examination is otherwise calm and alert. Assessment: Panic disorder. Plan: a prescription was issued to help manage anxiety symptoms. He was advised to practise slow breathing during attacks, reduce caffeine, and start counselling sessions. Follow-up in 4 weeks.

Visit note | 2025-02-25 04:00 PM | Dr. Anisur Rahman, Ophthalmology | Patient: Rezaul Kabir, 47, male.
